lines.zh: 如果你总是随叫随到，就会慢慢变得可有可无。
lines.en: If you are always on call, you slowly become optional.

lines.zh: 《人间失格》里也说过类似的话。
lines.en: No Longer Human says something similar.

lines.zh: 我们总以为，真心能换来真心，
lines.en: We always believe sincerity earns sincerity,

lines.zh: 可现实却是，你给得越多，别人越觉得理所当然。
lines.en: but the more you give, the more others take it for granted.

lines.zh: 消息你秒回，对方隔天才回一个“嗯”；
lines.en: You reply in seconds; they answer a day later with "ok";

lines.zh: 朋友随口说想吃什么，你下班绕路去买；
lines.en: a friend mentions a craving, and you detour after work to buy it;

lines.zh: 聚会你订位、张罗、买单，最后连句谢谢都没有。
lines.en: you book, organize and pay for the dinner, and no one even says thanks.

lines.zh: 你开始怀疑，自己是不是在热脸贴冷屁股。
lines.en: You start to wonder if you're just trying too hard for nothing.

lines.zh: 经济学里有个概念，叫边际效用递减。
lines.en: Economics has a concept: diminishing marginal utility.

lines.zh: 简单来说，给得越多，每一份就越不值钱。
lines.en: Simply put, the more you give, the less each piece is worth.

lines.zh: 第一颗糖最甜，第十颗只剩下腻。
lines.en: The first candy is the sweetest; the tenth is just too much.

lines.zh: 你以为对方变冷淡了，其实他只是习惯了；
lines.en: You think they've gone cold, but they've simply gotten used to it;

lines.zh: 你以为再多给一点就会被看见，
lines.en: you think a little more will finally get you noticed,

lines.zh: 其实给得越多，你越像空气，
lines.en: but the more you give, the more you become like air.

lines.zh: 人离不开空气，却从来不会感谢空气。
lines.en: People can't live without air, yet no one ever thanks it.

lines.zh: 我大学时，每天给室友带早饭，带了整整一学期。
lines.en: In college, I brought my roommate breakfast every day for a whole term.

lines.zh: 有一天我起晚了，空着手进门，
lines.en: One day I overslept and walked in empty-handed,

lines.zh: 她头都没抬：“今天怎么没带啊？”
lines.en: she didn't even look up: "Why didn't you bring it today?"

lines.zh: 那一刻我站在门口，脸一下烫了。
lines.en: I stood at the door, my face burning.

lines.zh: 原来我的好，早就从礼物变成了义务。
lines.en: My kindness had long turned from a gift into a duty.

lines.zh: 太宰治还写过一句：
lines.en: Dazai also wrote:

lines.zh: 倘若没有过度的欢喜，便不会有极度的悲伤。
lines.en: Without excessive joy, there would be no extreme sorrow.

lines.zh: 太过热情的背后，往往藏着一份没说出口的期待：
lines.en: Behind too much warmth there is often an unspoken expectation:

lines.zh: 我对你这么好，你也该这样对我。
lines.en: I've been so good to you, so you should be the same to me.

lines.zh: 期待越满，落空时就越疼。
lines.en: The fuller the expectation, the more it hurts when it falls through.

lines.zh: 那些糖看似给了别人，其实是在替自己讨一点甜。
lines.en: That candy seems to be for others, but you're asking for a little sweetness yourself.

lines.zh: 你可以热情，但别一次把整罐糖倒空；
lines.en: You can be warm, but don't empty the whole jar at once;

lines.zh: 你可以真心，但要给自己留一颗。
lines.en: you can be sincere, but keep one piece for yourself.

lines.zh: 所谓珍惜，从来不是给得最多，
lines.en: Cherishing was never about giving the most,

lines.zh: 而是给得刚刚好，对方才尝得出甜。
lines.en: but giving just enough that the other can still taste the sweetness.
